name: CAB Check Agent
notes: Checks sample IT change requests against a sample CAB rule book (no CAB, CAB or Emergency CAB, with risk, rule-cited reasons, approvals, blockers and the next CAB date), now flags risks in the description that the form missed with a word check even when AI is off, and AI adds a closer read, a plain summary, a CAB paper and an email to the change owner; assumes the rule book, CAB day and freeze dates are samples to be replaced by the change manager. Reviewed for the brief and manager ready.
desc: Tells IT staff whether a change needs CAB, Emergency CAB or no CAB, with the rule behind each reason, the approvals and the next CAB date. It flags risks hidden in the description and drafts the CAB paper and an email to the change owner.
tested: Playwright at 1280x800 light and 390x844 dark: checked CHG-4103 (word match flag for the firewall, Add to change updates the verdict), CHG-4106 (personal information flag and freeze blocker), a new blank change (required field errors, step tabs blocked until fixed, then verdict and email with [Change owner] placeholder), Submission with both Copy buttons and their Draft in Outlook links, How CAB works search, Steps to productionise panel, All AI prototypes button, chip focus kept after toggling; no page or console errors and scrollWidth equal to viewport. AI path with a stand-in: flags with quotes not found in the change are dropped, cites are checked against the rule book, and no requester name, email or phone appears in either prompt.
